name: Riyadh Cement Company
summary: Riyadh Cement Company, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a producer and supplier of various cement products across several Middle Eastern nations. The company's market reach extends to Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Qatar, and Oman. Its diverse portfolio includes both white and grey cement, alongside specialized varieties such as white Portland, Portland limestone, sulphate resisting Portland, and ordinary Portland cement. Founded in 1997, the organization was initially known as Saudi White Cement Company before rebranding to Riyadh Cement Company in February 2021.
